spec_features.feature_name: give_up sentinel (stop at budget or sentinel)
spec_features.spec_quote: Stop at the budget or when the model emits the `<<GIVE_UP>>` sentinel
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:24 GIVE_UP_SENTINEL='<<GIVE_UP>>'; in run_rollout loop: 'if GIVE_UP_SENTINEL in (comp.text or ""): turn_stop = "give_up"' and later 'if turn_stop == "give_up": stop_reason = "give_up"; break'. The sentinel is also delivered to the subject inside SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py ~30). The break actually terminates the loop, so the subject can end the episode.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired: detected in assistant text, recorded as stop_reason, and breaks the turn loop. Subject is instructed it 'may emit' the token to stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: If, and only if, you decide you cannot make further progress, you may emit the exact token <<GIVE_UP>> in your message to stop.

spec_features.feature_name: give_up sentinel optional for the model
spec_features.spec_quote: A `give_up` sentinel the model may but need not use
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as above (harness.py): the loop only checks for the sentinel; nothing forces or requires it. SYSTEM_PROMPT phrases it as 'you may emit the exact token <<GIVE_UP>>'. If never emitted, the loop simply runs to turn_budget. So it is genuinely optional and honored when used.
spec_features.notes: This is the same enforced exit mechanism; the 'may but need not' aspect is satisfied because emission is purely opt-in and only branched on if present.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: you may emit the exact token <<GIVE_UP>> in your message to stop. Otherwise, continue working.

spec_features.evidence: harness.py run_rollout: 'budget = task.turn_budget' and 'for turn_index in range(budget):' — the loop is hard-bounded by the per-task turn budget; on the last turn 'elif turn_index == budget - 1: turn_stop = "turn_budget"' and stop_reason defaults to 'turn_budget'. task.turn_budget is loaded from each task manifest (build_tasks.py turn_budget values 3/3/3/30/5; config.DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced cap that bounds total interaction length. Note 30-turn 'extended' budget is large; still a real cap.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It runs the loop up to the category's turn budget or until the model emits the give_up sentinel
